sovereign_fork.architecture_role: Browser Harness Bridge / SurfaceDriver Core Substrate

invariants: Fork upstream once sovereignly; do not create one fork per provider
Surface-specific DOM/auth behavior lives in adapters/drivers, not duplicated core logic
Browser session != harness identity != institutional holon
Ryan, Hermes, Codex, Claude, Antigravity, Jules, Qwen may consume the bridge without becoming the bridge
Authentication, cookies, tokens remain provider-local and are never committed
Tool/capability semantics originate from Agent OS Capability Fabric
Operation-scoped authority and fencing remain mandatory for consequential effects
Every browser action claiming external effect must return evidence/readback, not DOM-click success alone
Context/session reuse is transport optimization, never durable memory authority
The bridge must remain replaceable without renaming/recreating institutional holons
